cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Widgets Test)

# Data-driven node-type registry (NodeTypeRegistry : NodeTypeProvider), the
# NodePalette drag source and the NodeInspector property editor. All node
# knowledge comes from node_types.json (regenerated by
# extract_node_types.js from the frozen web sources; see
# desktop/docs/mbd_graph_contract.md §6 D1), embedded as a Qt resource. This
# library depends only on the contract/ headers — never on studio_mbd or
# studio_project (parallel Phase-1 work by Agents A and C).
qt_add_resources(NODE_TYPES_QRC_SOURCES node_types.qrc)

add_library(studio_mbd_nodes STATIC
    node_type_registry.cpp
    node_type_registry.h
    node_palette.cpp
    node_palette.h
    node_inspector.cpp
    node_inspector.h
    ${NODE_TYPES_QRC_SOURCES}
)
set_target_properties(studio_mbd_nodes PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
target_compile_features(studio_mbd_nodes PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(studio_mbd_nodes PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../contract
)
target_link_libraries(studio_mbd_nodes PUBLIC Qt6::Core Qt6::Widgets)

enable_testing()

# --- node_types.json drift test: runs extract_node_types.js --check ---
# Mirrors pin_check_runner_test's findNodeExecutable() pattern: skip (not
# fail) when node isn't available.
add_executable(node_types_drift_test tests/node_types_drift_test.cpp)
set_target_properties(node_types_drift_test PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
target_link_libraries(node_types_drift_test PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Test)
target_compile_definitions(node_types_drift_test PRIVATE
    EXTRACT_SCRIPT_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/extract_node_types.js"
    NODE_TYPES_JSON_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/node_types.json"
    GRAPH_EDITOR_HTML_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../mbd/editor/src/graph_editor.html"
    GRAPH_TO_C_JS_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../mbd/codegen/graph_to_c.js"
    SELFTEST_SCRIPT_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/extract_node_types_selftest.js")
add_test(NAME node_types_drift COMMAND node_types_drift_test)
set_tests_properties(node_types_drift PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen" TIMEOUT 30)

# --- NodeTypeRegistry / NodePalette / NodeInspector unit tests ---
add_executable(node_type_registry_test tests/node_type_registry_test.cpp)
set_target_properties(node_type_registry_test PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
target_link_libraries(node_type_registry_test PRIVATE studio_mbd_nodes Qt6::Test)
target_compile_definitions(node_type_registry_test PRIVATE
    NODE_TYPES_JSON_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/node_types.json")
add_test(NAME node_type_registry COMMAND node_type_registry_test)
set_tests_properties(node_type_registry PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen" TIMEOUT 30)

add_executable(node_palette_test tests/node_palette_test.cpp)
set_target_properties(node_palette_test PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
target_link_libraries(node_palette_test PRIVATE studio_mbd_nodes Qt6::Test)
add_test(NAME node_palette COMMAND node_palette_test)
set_tests_properties(node_palette PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen" TIMEOUT 30)

add_executable(node_inspector_test tests/node_inspector_test.cpp tests/fake_inspector_source.h)
set_target_properties(node_inspector_test PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
target_link_libraries(node_inspector_test PRIVATE studio_mbd_nodes Qt6::Test)
target_compile_definitions(node_inspector_test PRIVATE
    HARDWARE_FIXTURE_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/hardware_fixture.json")
add_test(NAME node_inspector COMMAND node_inspector_test)
set_tests_properties(node_inspector PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen" TIMEOUT 30)
